The change goes in a new migration file, `migrations/0008_add_customer_phone.sql`. Don't edit `0007_add_customers.sql`, which creates the table. The project's memory says files in `migrations/` are applied in production and must never be edited. The latest one is `0007`, so `0008` is the next number.

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made the column nullable, so existing rows don't need a value. If you want `NOT NULL`, you'd need a `DEFAULT` too.

`0007` has a typo, `emial` instead of `email`. I haven't touched it, because it's already applied. If you want it fixed, that would be a separate `0009` migration with `ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;`.
